Hi Alex —

Quick intro: I own compliance intake for Redwood’s enterprise team. Thanks for the fast response to the intake form — we did a pass and it looks like the SIG questionnaire maps best to the scope you selected, but we can do CAIQ if your procurement/security team prefers that format.

Can you confirm:
- Do you want the full SIG (matrix + attachments) or a condensed CAIQ export?
- Who at Zenluma will be the day-to-day evidence owner (name + email)?
- Do you need a short runbook/demo of how we deliver log samples and key artifacts?

Proposed 30‑minute slots (PT):
- Mon Apr 12 10:00–10:30
- Tue Apr 13 14:00–14:30
- Wed Apr 14 09:30–10:00

I’ve attached a quick packet (Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx) that lists typical artifact asks and an evidence guidance PDF so you can preview what we’ll request. If you share your SOC 2 cert or scope doc in advance it speeds the intake.

If none of those windows work, tell me a couple that do and we’ll mirror Zenluma’s timezone.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—Marissa

Alex — thanks for the quick answers and for the scope doc. Confirming Tue Apr 13 14:00–14:30 PT. I’ve sent a calendar invite with a short agenda. Meeting link and runbook are below.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5m introductions + scope alignment (we’ll call out what we see in your scope doc)
2) 10m questionnaire format (SIG matrix + how we tag evidence)
3) 10m log sampling & artifact handoff (expected formats, retention windows, redaction guidance)
4) 5m next steps & owners (deliverables and timeline)

Log retention guidance: For the intake, a 30‑day sample is sufficient to validate logging controls and parity with our collection. If you can stage 90 days we’ll take it, but it’s not required for the initial SIG pass. For production evidence (if you move forward) we typically ask for either pre-signed temporary access or an S3 bucket + minimal IAM role to fetch archives.

Pre-call asks (please upload before the meeting if possible):
- SOC 2 PDF (if available)
- Network boundary diagram (redacted if needed)
- One example log file (gzip, anonymized)

Runbook / links: https://drive.redwood.com/zenluma/sig-runbook
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-456091 (I’ll attach the intake record to the call notes)

I attached a revised packet that maps typical SIG fields to concrete examples from other health customers — should make the call faster.

See you Tue.

—Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Packet_v1.xlsx (updated)
